Relief shown pictorially. Does not show military features. Meridians numbered eastward from unspecified prime (Long Island at 308⁰E). Watermarked [crowned head?]. Originally printed on 4 sheets. Includes pictorial title cartouche and ill. of ships at sea. At foot of cartouche: XIV. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Purchased with funds from the Madison Council. In German. LC copy fold-lined. Vault Acquisitions control no.: 97-26
